name: bhm-codex-connector
description: Windows-focused Codex connector for the workspace BHM ritual and canonical BHM MCP workflow

interface.shortDescription: Workspace BHM connector for Codex on Windows
interface.longDescription: Bundles the BHM workspace ritual and skills; host clients own one canonical BHM MCP registration so non-trivial Codex sessions can start with memory preflight, stay runtime-aware, and close with checkpoint or session record on this Windows workstation.
defaultPrompt: Start the task with the local BHM ritual for this workspace.
Close the task with checkpoint and session record using the local BHM ritual.
Discover the local BHM runtime and summarize whether it is usable.
